rules.note: Completed nomination form, submitted in the first stage to the authority in your country (ministry, embassy or similar) that nominates candidates.
Copy of a valid passport that confirms your identity. Upload as PDF, notarised, in Azerbaijani, Turkish, English or Russian, or with a notarised English translation.

Copy of your diploma from school or university. Notarised, in Azerbaijani, Turkish, English or Russian, or with a notarised English translation. Your marks must be at least 70 out of 100 (or 7 out of 10).
Copy of your transcript from school or university. Notarised, in Azerbaijani, Turkish, English or Russian, or with a notarised English translation. Marks must be at least 70/100 (7/10).
Medical certificate with HIV/AIDS and hepatitis B/C tests, from a clinic in your country of residence, dated within 3 months before you apply and showing you are fit to travel and study.
Only if you will study in English: IELTS 5.0 (TOEFL 40) for undergraduate, IELTS 5.5 (TOEFL 50) for postgraduate, or your previous education was in English.
Only if you will study in English: IELTS 5.0 or TOEFL 40, or your previous education was in English.
Only if you will study in English: IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 50, or your previous education was in English.
Only if you will study in English: IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 50, or your previous education was in English.

Only if you will study in Russian, Turkish or Azerbaijani: proof of that language, or your previous education was in it. If you will study in Azerbaijani, proof of English, Russian or Turkish is accepted.
Local and international awards, if you have any.
Not listed in the official requirements.
